claims.statement: For a literal physical cross block C=A[H,L] with |H|=m>=2 and s1(C)s2(C)>=sigma, some literal row pair T has area S>=sigma/sqrt(binomial(m,2)). If rho=||C[H\T,L](I-Pi_row(C[T,L]))||F>0, the full ambient law has a continuous C0 density with ||p_Q||infinity <=3*2^(5/6)(S rho)^(-1/3). The proof uses the grouped projected-crossing theorem when all transverse row marginals are <=1/2, and otherwise a literal three-row exact-rank-three crossing.

In the account01/B20 finite-core rank-two branch |H|<=124, s1(A[H,L])s2(A[H,L])>1/480, if the selected literal two-row span has transverse Frobenius residual at least 1/64 then ||p_Q||infinity<743 and the density is continuous C0.
Every still-unpaid state in that rank-two branch admits a literal row pair T with sqrt(det(C[T,L]C[T,L]^T))>1/(480*sqrt(7626)) and ||C[H\T,L](I-Pi_row(C[T,L]))||F<1/64.
